app.title: be-a.network
app.subtitle: Be a switch. Be a router. Learn networking by making the decisions yourself.

home.switch.title: BeASwitch
home.switch.description: Learn how an Ethernet switch builds its MAC address table and forwards frames across VLANs.
home.router.title: BeARouter
home.router.description: Decide which interface a packet leaves through, using longest prefix match.
home.quiz.title: IP Quiz
home.quiz.description: Practise subnetting, netmask conversion, IPv6 abbreviation and EUI-64.
home.mode.practiceHint: Endless rounds, no pass or fail.
home.mode.examHint: A fixed number of rounds, ending in a summary.
home.goalDescription: Correct answers out of total attempts
home.useVlanHint: Turn off for a simpler switch without tagging.
home.reducedMotionHint: Skip animations and show results immediately.
home.noPassedExams: No exams passed yet. Switch an exercise to exam mode and reach its goal to add one here.

switch.title: BeASwitch
switch.intro: Press Start to receive a frame.
switch.macTablesEmpty: The MAC address tables are still empty.
switch.entryQuestion: Does the switch need a new MAC address table entry?
switch.entryRequired: Yes, a new entry is required
switch.entryNotRequired: No, the address is already known
switch.selectPorts: Select every port the frame is sent out of, and tick Tag where the frame must carry a VLAN tag.
switch.markAllExceptInbound: Select all except the inbound port
switch.action.broadcast: Unknown destination: the frame is flooded within VLAN {vlan}.
switch.action.unicast: Known destination: the frame is forwarded to port {port} in VLAN {vlan}.
switch.expectedEntry: A new entry was required for {mac} on port {port}.
switch.unknownHost: Station that has not sent yet
router.title: BeARouter
router.intro: Press Start to receive a packet.
router.selectInterface: Select the interface the packet leaves through.
router.expectedDrop: No route matches, so the packet is dropped.
router.explainIntro: Each row applies its own netmask to the destination {ip} and compares the result with the route's network.
router.explainNoWinner: No route matches, so the packet is dropped.
quiz.title: IP Quiz
question.networkAddress: What is the network address of {subject}?
question.broadcast: What is the broadcast address of {subject}?
question.numberOfHosts: How many usable host addresses does {subject} have?
question.splitSubnetSecond: Divide {subject} into {subject2} subnets. What is the second resulting subnet?
question.splitSubnetThird: Divide {subject} into {subject2} subnets. What is the third resulting subnet?
question.cidrToDotted: What is the dotted decimal netmask for /{subject}?
question.dottedToCidr: What is the prefix length (CIDR) for {subject}?
question.prefixToPurpose: What is the purpose of the IPv6 prefix {subject}?
question.purposeToPrefix: Which IPv6 prefix is used for {subject}?
question.eui64: Which IPv6 address results from EUI-64 with MAC {subject} in {subject2}?
